input.brief: Chillar: 9:16 Hinglish finance explainer reels for Gen Z India; motif is an Indian bank passbook, rubber stamps, printed receipts, a deadpan ₹1 coin mascot

direction.name: Colour chapters
direction.idea: Every section is a chapter with its own flat colour, floor to ceiling. The page reads like a set of posters hung in a row, held together by one typeface and one grid. The colours are not decoration: they come from the subject (the brand's packaging, the artist's record sleeves, the product's own colour ways, the categories of the content) and each chapter's colour means that chapter. Decide the sequence like a designer orders a book: a strong opener, a quiet second, a surprise in the middle, a dark or very light closer.
direction.composition: Sections are full-bleed fields, each at least 90svh tall, butted directly against each other with no gap and no divider. Inside every field the same 12-column grid and the same margins apply, and each field holds one thing: a huge heading (8–12vw) with a small paragraph, or one photograph with a caption, or one list. Text colour is chosen per field for strong contrast (ink or paper, never grey). Headings start on the same left edge in every chapter, so the eye feels the system as colours change. The navigation and the footer take the colours of the first and last chapter.
direction.typography: One typeface in two weights. Headings very large and tight; body 18–20px. Because colour is loud, the type stays plain: no italics, no second face.
direction.colour: Four to six flat fields used at full strength, one per section, each with its assigned text colour. No tints, no gradients between them: the hard edge where two fields meet is the look.
direction.imagery: Sparing. One photograph or object per chapter at most, either cut out and sitting directly on the colour, or a plain rectangle with generous colour around it. Photographs should be simple enough not to fight the field.
direction.richness: Colour at scale. A whole screen of one saturated colour is rich on its own, so a chapter needs few elements; it still needs its content at full size, because a coloured screen with one small line on it reads as empty.
direction.pitfalls: Check contrast on every field with the palette's assigned ink. Do not put cards on the fields. Do not use more than six colours. Two neighbouring fields should differ clearly in lightness as well as hue.

hero.name: Giant cropped shape
hero.blueprint: A plain ground with one flat shape at enormous scale. The shape is the simplest geometry found in the subject (a circle, a ring segment, a chamfered block, an arch), drawn in CSS or as a single inline SVG path and filled with the accent colour. It is about 120vh across and enters from the right, centred near 78% of the width and 55% of the height, so the top, right and bottom edges of the viewport crop it and its left boundary reaches column 7. If the subject has a true pair (two accounts, two modes), a second shape in a second flat colour overlaps the first by a quarter with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. The headline sits on the bare ground on columns 1–6, vertically centred, flush left at 8% from the left edge: two lines at clamp(64px, 6.4vw, 100px), heavy weight, tracking -0.03em. Beneath it comes one supporting sentence at 19px, then the single action as a solid button cut to the same shape. A bold wordmark sits top-left at 32px; up to three text links sit top-right in the ground colour.
hero.mobile: The shape moves to the bottom: 130vw across, centred horizontally, its top at 56svh, cropped by the left, right and bottom edges. The headline sits above it at 11.5vw on two lines at a 16px margin, starting 15% down, with the sentence at 16px and the motif-shaped button beneath. Wordmark top-left; the links collapse to one word top-right.
hero.headline: Two lines of two or three words each, up to about 12 characters per line at 6.4vw.

type.note: A geometric black with round bowls and flat terminals, cleaner and more even than a grotesque at the same weight. Suits fintech, apps and portfolios that want heavy type with a tidy, technical finish.

palette.name: Candy on black
palette.note: Black ground and dark photographs take nearly all of the surface. The only flat colour is a solid block behind each title, which takes a new candy pastel per project (mint, cyan, lemon, orange, cornflower); cyan is the default for the button.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Statement tiles
sections.blueprint: A board of filled tiles with 8px gaps and 8px outer margins: 12 columns by two rows of 38svh each. Tile A, columns 1–8 across both rows, is the darkest tile and carries a slogan of two to four words in capitals at clamp(64px, 9vw, 132px), leading 0.86, on two lines, set hard against the tile's 20px left padding and bottom-aligned. Tile B, columns 9–12 of row one, is a pale tile with one word or figure at the same size, bottom-aligned, cropped by `overflow: hidden` if it runs long. Tile C, columns 9–12 of row two, is a photograph covering the tile. Below the board a fourth tile spans all 12 columns in the page ground colour: its left half is empty and a text of 90–130 words at 22–24px with leading 1.35 runs in columns 7–12 with 40px padding. No separate heading: the slogan in tile A is the heading.
sections.mobile: A two-column board with 6px gaps. The slogan tile spans both columns at 46svh with type at 17vw on two lines; the word tile and the photograph tile sit side by side as squares; the long text tile spans both columns with 20px padding at 18px.

sections.name: Bars standing on the edge
sections.blueprint: The product's own chart, drawn in HTML, is the whole section. A full-bleed field 90svh tall. Along its bottom edge stand ten to fourteen solid bars, one per true value (months, releases, cohorts), in a CSS grid spanning the full viewport width with 8px gaps and no side margins; heights are the values scaled so the tallest is 58vh. No axes, no grid, no legend; the chart's root is marked data-ui. Every bar is one tone two steps from the field except the one the page is about, which takes the accent. Three bars print their value directly above themselves at clamp(20px, 2vw, 30px), tabular. The headline figure sits top-left on the page margin at clamp(88px, 10vw, 168px), and its claim, two to five words at 28px, sits beneath it on the same margin. Hovering or focusing a bar shows its value and period above it.
sections.mobile: Bars run sideways: each a full-width row 28px tall growing from the left edge, 6px gaps, eight values at most. The headline figure sits above at 26vw with its claim at 22px. Three rows print their value at 17px inside the bar's right end. The accent row stays.

sections.name: Cards that fold into spines
sections.blueprint: For a journal, a run of notes or a list of chapters without pictures. A wrapper about 400svh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh. The heading, two to four words at clamp(48px, 4.2vw, 64px), sits top-left on the 32px margin, 120px from the top. Under it a band 360px tall spans the content width and holds a horizontal deck of text cards, each about 620px wide, in three neighbouring flat tones of one hue taken in turn. On a card, with 32px padding: its title at 30px on up to two lines, leading 1.1; an excerpt of two lines at 16px; and along the bottom edge the date on the left and a text link to read it on the right, both at 16px. As the page scrolls, each step slides the next card in from the right edge and squeezes the earlier ones into slivers 120px wide stacked edge to edge at the left, like book spines, where only the first letters of their titles show, clipped by the sliver. Clicking a sliver brings its card back. 48px under the band, the number of entries and a link to the full list sit at 17px on the left margin, so the stage does not end on an empty floor.
sections.mobile: No pin and no slivers. The cards stack at full width with 12px gaps, each in its tone, the title at 24px, the excerpt at 16px, the date and link at the foot. The heading sits above them at 10vw.

sections.name: The action tile
sections.blueprint: The close is one row of the board. Three filled tiles sit side by side with 8–14px gaps, all 360px tall and sharing one radius: a wide centre tile spanning columns 3–10 in the accent colour, flanked by two narrow tiles (columns 1–2 and 11–12) that run off the left and right viewport edges, as if the row had been cropped from a longer one. The centre tile holds, left-aligned and vertically centred with 40px padding: a heading of three to five words at 40px, two lines at 17px, and the action. The action is either one rectangular button or an email field 420px wide in the paper colour with the submit button nested inside its right end. The flanking tiles hold no text: one is a photograph covering the tile, the other a flat palette colour. No shadows, no outlines.
sections.mobile: The accent tile runs full width, about 300px tall, heading at 28px, field and button stacked at full width. The two flanking tiles follow beneath as a pair, each half width and 120px tall, with the same gap and the same radius.

references.name: Ai in Design Report 2026
references.idea: A research report laid out like a colour-blocked print annual: a thermal-blurred video collage on top, an oversized tight grotesk title, and flat orange, lilac, sage and black blocks carrying stats, quotes and chapters.
references.hero: The top 53% is a full-width video band: blurred, heat-map-like abstract footage in orange, lilac and sage, overlaid with four or five hard-edged rectangles of the same footage in grey or green, two tagged with tiny mono labels in white boxes. The header sits flush on top: a black logo block at far left, an orange link tab running to 40% of the width, two plain links at right. Below the band, on white: a two-line deck at about 1.4vw on a 1% left margin, and from 42% across a two-line title at 8.3vw, medium weight, tracking -0.06em. Bottom row: mono credit left, scroll cue and arrow aligned to the title column.
references.type: Beausite Classic, a grotesk with some stroke contrast, in Medium for titles and Regular for text; sentence case, tracking -0.06em at display size. Geist Mono for small uppercase labels. Steps: 8.3vw title, about 5.5vw numerals, about 3vw statements, 16px body, 10px mono. Footer wordmark near 96vw.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #fe7141 #cdabfe #d1ddd3 #f0ff1c — White base with flat blocks of orange, lilac, sage and black assigned to whole modules (stat tiles, quote panels, chapter bands), all drawn from the hero footage. Text is black, or off-white on black.
references.imagery: Hero: abstract blurred video with a heat-map grade, cut into overlapping rectangles. Body: warm documentary photos and clips of people at desks in wood-lined rooms, square-cornered, butted directly against flat colour blocks with no gap.
references.layout: 1% margins and a recurring column line at about 42% where most headings and text begin. Open white text passages ruled by hairlines alternate with tight mosaics in which photos and colour blocks share edges. Each chapter opens with a full-width colour band.

sections.description: A full-width hairline, a tiny mono label at the left, then seven black partner logos evenly spaced across the full width in one row with generous padding above and below, closed by a second hairline. Immediately beneath, another mono label and a three-line statement at about 3vw, flush left and occupying only the left half, followed by a full-width photo strip.

A mosaic with no gutters. A photo of two people at a laptop fills the left two-thirds at roughly 1:1; the right third is split into two stacked flat tiles, lilac above and sage below. Each tile carries a large numeral with a plus sign at about 5.5vw in its top-left corner and a two-line caption directly beneath; the rest of the tile is empty colour.

Quote module as two abutting blocks: a black block on the left 40% holding only a small name and a mono role caption, and a sage block on the right 60% with the quotation at about 3vw, top-left aligned with empty sage beneath. Directly below, a full-width orange band opens a chapter: hairline at top, a large two-digit number with the chapter word under it at left, a two-line title and small paragraph starting at the 42% column.

Black footer. A row of three small source counts along the top, separated by vertical hairlines, then the report name in off-white heavy type at nearly full viewport width with a trademark sign at its top-right, then the year at the same size right-aligned on a second line. Two small link columns with mono headings sit lower left beside the year; a hairline and one row of credits and partner logos close it.

steal: Start most headings and text at a fixed column line about 42% across, leaving the left for small decks, credits and chapter numbers.
Butt flat colour tiles directly against a photograph with no gutter and put one large numeral plus two caption lines in each tile's top-left corner.
Take the page's flat block colours from the hero footage so the abstract video and the layout read as one palette.
references.media: A video collage covers 100% of the screen at load and lifts to the top ~53% to uncover the title on white. Below, a documentary photograph two thirds wide in a sticky frame beside stacked colour stat blocks, a pinned deck of colour cards each with a 10s clip docked bottom-left, and a carousel of equal stills running off the right edge: 12 images and 6 muted videos, all square-cornered.
references.motion: No preloader, but the collage re-cuts itself for about 4s before the title lands. Framer drives the sticky stacking (a 1350px photo frame and three 900px chapter cards that peel away to uncover the next); there is no split text, links change colour over .2s cubic-bezier(.44,0,.56,1), and one panel slides 610px in over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.44,0,0.37,1).

references.name: Aardvark Book Club
references.idea: A book club dressed as a sweet shop: fat black type, tumbling 3D books and boxes on wavy colour fields, annotated with handwritten asides.
references.hero: A saturated yellow field with two large wavy blobs, pale yellow then orange, rising from the bottom. A three-line headline in Champ Bold, black, at about 8.3vw with leading under 0.85, is flush to a 15px left margin and reaches 60% across. Beneath it: a four-line paragraph 310px wide and a magenta split button (label plus arrow square). Right of centre a 3D hardback in navy and pink tilts 20 degrees, 600px tall; another book is cropped by the top-left corner, a third by the bottom edge. A purple handwritten note sits rotated at far right. Nav: pale-yellow pill links centred, an orange login button, black round social icons.
references.type: Champ Bold, an ultra-heavy wide sans with a looped g, for headings at 120px with tight tracking and leading; Degular for 18px body and pill labels; a purple handwritten script (Hello Organichand) for rotated margin notes and step labels. Three distinct voices.
references.colour: #ffd249 #faed8f #f9a21f #ffdbfd #a4f6f8 #fd48f2 — Each section owns one flat candy colour: yellow hero, white shelf, pink steps, cyan unboxing, deep violet footer. Type stays black; buttons are magenta.
references.imagery: 3D-rendered hardbacks and a patterned shipping box, cut out and tilted, floating over flat wavy vector shapes; real book covers on tilted coloured cards; black line drawings of figures on step cards. Nothing sits square to the grid.
references.layout: Sections are full-width panels with roughly 80px corner radius inset about 20px from the viewport, each a different colour. Headings alternate left and centre; cards overlap and rotate a few degrees; handwritten notes are tucked beside headings at an angle.

sections.description: White band. A centred black heading at 5.5vw over a two-line subline, with a rotated handwritten note at its upper left. Below, a horizontal row of book covers, each on a rounded colour-matched card with a small tag pill at top-left; cards tilt alternately by 3 degrees at staggered heights, the last cropped by the right edge, with two round arrow buttons above at right. Later, covers give way to same-coloured info cards with genre pills, heavy title and blurb.

A pale-pink rounded panel with lighter wavy shapes inside. Heavy black heading at left with a handwritten aside beside it; a small round logo stamp and a magenta split button at right. Along the bottom, four portrait cards about 250px wide in cyan, magenta, yellow and violet overlap like a fanned hand, each rotated a few degrees, with a handwritten step label at top, a black line drawing in the middle and a heavy caption at the foot.

A full-viewport cyan rounded panel containing only a 3D shipping box wrapped in a wavy magenta, violet and black pattern, centred. Across the scroll it goes from closed and tilted to lid open, growing to about 57% of the viewport width, with a single handwritten note at its right. No heading and no button.

The preceding white section ends in large rounded bottom corners over a deep violet footer. Left: white logo, two store badges, two magenta round social icons. Centre: the patterned box again, cropped by the bottom edge. Right: a small heavy heading, a white rounded email field and a magenta split button. A black legal strip closes the page.

steal: Give each section one flat saturated colour inside a large-radius inset panel and keep the type black across all of them.
Add rotated handwritten margin notes beside headings to carry secondary facts in a second voice.
Fan step cards so they overlap and tilt instead of sitting in an even grid.
references.media: About 60% of the first screen is picture: a 3D book and cropped book corners over a full-bleed illustrated wave field. Below come a sticky image-sequence of a box opening inside a rounded panel, a slider of tilted cards bleeding off the right edge, covers fanned like a hand of cards, a sticker collage round a circular badge and a cut-out box rising out of the footer: 37 images and two scroll-scrubbed canvases, no video.
references.motion: An indigo transition panel wipes away by 1.2s while the headline arrives word by word (515 split characters), and Lenis then drives the scrubbed scenes: the hero book turns through an image sequence, a sticky stage scrubs the box opening over 2745px, a headline slides along a curved path at scrub 0.5, and the footer is uncovered from under the rounded page. Buttons squash to 0.955 by 0.925 in 0.15s on press, the main ease is cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), and the bounce overshoots are ones the house motion layer does not use, though the site ships 32 reduced-motion rules.

references.name: Sharplink
references.idea: A crypto treasury presented as precision hardware: chrome machined parts and glass capsules rendered in 3D on deep blue, overlaid with dashed machine-vision tracking boxes.
references.hero: Full-bleed video of exploded brushed-metal components floating on a navy-to-cobalt gradient, covered by a web of thin white dashed lines and small square tracking markers. Logo top-left on a 2% margin; top-right a segmented strip of five dark rectangular tabs in narrow uppercase plus an arrow square. The headline is top-left, two lines at 6.1vw in regular weight with -0.03em tracking, starting 18% down. Under it two stacked rectangular buttons: white with a blue arrow square attached, then a translucent dark one. Bottom row: a stock-exchange badge at left, a three-line lead paragraph at about 1.3vw starting 26% across, and bottom-right a translucent dark news card about 30% wide.
references.type: Archivo regular for headlines (88px in the hero, about 3vw in sections) and 16px body; Archivo Narrow in bold uppercase with wide tracking for nav, buttons and tiny labels. Headlines never go bold: hierarchy comes from size and from fading inactive items to grey.
references.colour: #050c17 #0e3f97 #e6edf7 #a7a8ab #1f6bff #ffffff — One blue family from near-black navy through cobalt to icy white; sections are vertical blue gradients, light or dark. Bright blue appears only as tiny square markers and arrow buttons; chrome grey from the renders.
references.imagery: Chrome and glass 3D objects (exploded device parts, a spike-tipped capsule holding icons) lit coolly, often with dashed annotation lines or shown as dotted wireframes; full-bleed in the hero, floating free at the right in later sections.
references.layout: 2% margins and square corners everywhere. Sections are full-viewport gradient fields with a headline at left and a 3D object or data card at right; lists run as label, title and paragraph in two columns. Tiny blue square bullets mark section starts.

sections.description: Light icy-gradient section. A two-line headline in grey-blue at about 3vw at the left, with a small paragraph far below it at bottom-left. Centre: a tall 3:4 card with a navy-to-cobalt vertical gradient, a tiny uppercase label, a rising line chart over a faint dotted grid, and a full-width dark button at its base. Right third: three faint, nearly transparent rows, each with a small numbered tag, one line of text and a ghosted line drawing.

Pinned list beside a 3D object. Left 60%: stacked rows, each with a tiny uppercase label, a two-line title at about 1.3vw in a first column and a short paragraph in a second column starting 26% across. Only the active row is at full contrast; the rest are dimmed to roughly 40%. Right 40%: a chrome-and-glass capsule about 80% of the viewport tall whose interior icon changes per row. The ground shifts from icy white to deep cobalt partway through.

A black panel inset by 2% on a navy ground with small blue square markers at its corners. Logo mark top-left; a two-line statement at about 2vw at the left, first line white and second line grey; two rectangular buttons below. A dotted wireframe version of the capsule fills the right half. Under the panel, a tiny uppercase label at left and a small button at right.

Cobalt gradient footer: a newsletter line with an underlined email field at left, three small link columns across the middle and right, exchange badge and legal microtext below. The wordmark closes the page in letters spanning the full width, cropped by the bottom edge and fading from white at the top to transparent.

steal: Overlay a 3D render with thin dashed lines and tiny square markers linking its parts, as if a vision system were tracking the object.
Build buttons as square-cornered rectangles with a separate coloured arrow square attached to the right edge.
In a pinned list beside a 3D object, dim every row except the active one and change what sits inside the object for each row.
references.media: A full-bleed 12s loop of 3D chrome and glass objects covers the whole fold, with text docked in the four corners straight on it. Below: a 3D capsule pinned in the right third while a list of claims scrolls on the left, its inner emblem swapping per row, a dark card sliding over it that turns the covered part into a dashed wireframe, a sticky portrait video of chrome pipes at the right edge, and a full-width wordmark canvas cropped by the bottom of the viewport; square corners throughout.
references.motion: The hero is composed at 400ms with the video playing and no preloader (load 21.3s), and Lenis runs four pins over fixed layers: one fixed gradient layer behind everything crossfades the grounds, the capsule stays pinned across three sections as each claim brightens from about 40% to full, and the manifesto fills character by character (423 split characters). The workhorse ease is cubic-bezier(.455,.03,.515,.955), on 57 observed opacity, background and colour transitions at .25-.3s.
